title: Fresh Request Tuple for Operator-Local Clearance Path
summary: Create the FP-MCP-223 non-executing packet anchor so a fresh request artifact can be recorded against current ForgePilot HEAD after FP-MCP-222. The prior FP-MCP-209 request and FP-MCP-216 approval tuple is stale and must not be used for operator-local clearance. This checkpoint records preparation only and does not create local clearance, consume approval, clear the disable switch, contact the runner start endpoint, start OpenCode, or run FP-027.
caveats: Several attempted non-executing request artifact recordings for FP-MCP-223 failed closed with UNKNOWN_PACKET before this packet anchor existed; those attempts created no request artifact and did not authorize or start execution.
The old FP-MCP-209 tuple remains stale because its target execution commit is 4bd1977, while ForgePilot HEAD after FP-MCP-222 is 219fe9d before this checkpoint.
Fresh request and fresh approval must be bound to the post-checkpoint current HEAD, not to the old FP-MCP-209 tuple.
This checkpoint does not create the operator-local clearance artifact; that remains a human-local act outside the model-callable MCP surface under FP-MCP-217.

nextIntendedNonExecutingSteps: record fresh request artifact for FP-MCP-223 bound to current HEAD
create fresh structured human approval only with explicit operator approval fields
observe operator-local clearance only after human creates local artifact outside MCP
